mentions.name: Typod
mentions.description: This static site podcast player focuses on fast loading and minimal interaction with its repository: it processes images (converting to webp) and loads the podcast feed list from a Gist. It was rebuilt from the ground up using Opus 4.6 and a frontend-design skill, going from brief to ready-to-use in about a couple of hours.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Just tried out Opus 4.6 to make a ground-up new version of a perennial side project: static site podcast player.

For this one I focused on loading speed and reducing interaction with repo. So it processes the images (converting to webp) and loads the feed list from a Gist.
